name: FrooxEngine
description: Main target. Extends Flatweave/FrooxEngine (weave: flatten - the weaver's output is kept as source, no reweave): decompiles the whole assembly EXCEPT the types claimed by the FrooxEngine.Ext.* split targets (exclude_types = union of their select_types + the Fody marker), applies the Resonator patches, then this layer's ARM/platform patches. Built by the consumer's own csproj (generated/ + Injected/). Consumer code that adds Workers or sync-delegate targets must follow the Flatweave rules (README) - check with 'Resonator.Deweaver syncmembers'.
